vetSays.line: 🛡️ Evelyn, Patricia, Ursula and Mara met them at the door — 4 put down. Evelyn, Patricia, Ursula, Mara are hurt.
🛡️ Nora and Meera met them at the door — 2 put down. Nora, Meera are hurt.
⚠ This one is different — scarred, braced, waiting for your opening. A Scarred veteran.
🛡️ Patricia, Nora, Ursula and Meera met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 barely walked away. Patricia, Nora, Ursula, Meera are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Adaeze just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Bilal just put down The Loud Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Nora just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🛡️ Bilal, Patricia, Adaeze, Nora and Ursula met them at the door — 5 put down. Bilal, Patricia, Adaeze, Nora, Ursula are hurt.

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Nadia just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Dmitri just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Nadia just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Nadia, Farid and Dmitri met them at the door — 3 put down. Nadia, Farid, Dmitri are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Quinn just put down Big Ugly... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Farid and Quinn met them at the door — 2 put down. Farid, Quinn are hurt.
🛡️ Farid met them at the door — 1 put down. Farid is hurt.
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
🛡️ Miles, Rewi and Tom met them at the door — 1 put down, 2 barely walked away. Miles, Rewi, Tom are hurt.
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
Blooded — the village knows where the Producers bleed. (Strikes hit 1.5× as hard; their blows land at 0.75× strength.)
⚠ This one is different — old, patient, unhurried — it has seen your kind before. An Elder veteran.

⚠️ Two threats: Elder Ugly-Eyes and an eye-head (×4) — all here, all now.
Your party: just you. You are outnumbered — fight like it.
